required_adapters.note: A provider-neutral verifier now checks governed Aave V3 collateral and variable-debt positions, policy-pinned per-user token mapping slots, MPT account/storage proofs, reserve indexes, owner authorization, contract code hashes, Chainlink/capped-stable prices and freshness, conservative rounding, liabilities, and guest dispatch. Its public workflow constructs the deterministic checkpoint candidate, emits owner authorization, and collects every governed account and storage proof at the certified block. It reproduces the historical A666 collateral and debt values. Governed A666 policy/committee inputs, adversarial and fuzz qualification, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral successor verifier now checks an exact governed multichain native/ERC-20 position set, quorum-certified state roots and timestamps, account/storage MPT proofs, code hashes, owner authorization, decimals, omissions, duplicates, checked bounds, and guest dispatch. Its public workflow deterministically constructs each checkpoint candidate from a pinned RPC height, supports independent checkpoint voting/assembly, emits the complete owner-authorization statement, and collects the governed proof set from an exact RPC map. It reconstructs every native and ERC-20 proof in the historical A666 artifact. Prices remain a separate disclosed valuation trust dimension. The governed A666 policy/committee fixture, adversarial and fuzz qualification, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks the HyperEVM reader receipt, BFT-certified header, owner authorization, reader bytecode hash, exact policy-pinned spot and perpetual sets, positions, holds, values, liabilities, bounds, and guest dispatch. The hardened public HyperCore reader and public unsigned snapshot/checkpoint/owner/receipt-proof collection workflow reconstruct a real historical block and receipts trie without any StakeHub runtime input. HyperEVM does not expose a usable account state root or eth_getProof, so reader-code identity is explicitly BFT-checkpointed by independent validators while receipt inclusion and payload values remain cryptographic. Public deployment, governed A666 policy/committee inputs, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, independent reproduction, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks certified-head, outcome, block, reader, pool, implicit-account ownership, quantity, bounds, duplicate events, mainnet domain, and guest dispatch, with historical Merkle reconstruction. The public stateless reader accepts no funds and emits a canonical provider-neutral snapshot. The public CLI emits unsigned external-wallet invocation data, constructs an exact finalized-head checkpoint candidate, verifies policy-pinned reader and pool code hashes, collects and reconstructs the outcome/block proof, emits the exact owner statement, and verifies the complete quantity evidence without receiving a private key. Code identity and finality are explicitly BFT-checkpointed rather than mislabeled as direct NEAR consensus verification. Public reader deployment, governed policy/committee inputs, public NEAR/USD valuation evidence, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, independent reproduction, and production qualification remain open.

The historical signed-RPC verifier remains separately labeled attested. A distinct provider-neutral successor now includes a public stateless reserve-reader program, exact unsigned transaction construction for an external wallet, finalized transaction/block collection, immutable ProgramData identity checks, policy-pinned finality depth and maximum slot lag, exact stake/withdraw/vote authority and position verification, reserve-owner authorization, ML-DSA BFT checkpoint validation, bounded parsing, cryptographic guest dispatch, and an independently repeated reproducible SBF build pinned by exact tool, container, source, program, and raw ELF hashes. It does not trust an operator/RPC signature for the quantity and is explicitly cryptographic relative to the disclosed BFT checkpoint rather than direct Solana consensus verification. Immutable public deployment, governed A666 policy/committee and SOL/USD valuation inputs, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, independent reproduction, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral cryptographic quantity verifier now checks Monero transaction decoding and hashes, tx public keys, shared-secret ownership proofs, key-image ring signatures, subaddress spend-key proofs, RingCT amount recovery and commitments, transaction inclusion, block-header anchoring, BFT-certified head and key-image spent status, bounded inputs, exact NAV/profile/manifest/policy/epoch context, and guest dispatch. The public CLI emits the context-bound external-wallet challenge, canonically parses ReserveProofV2, collects and hash-checks complete transactions, blocks and transaction-tree branches, builds bounded header anchors, obtains the exact key-image status set, emits the independent checkpoint candidate, and verifies the assembled quantity and separate valuation evidence without receiving any private key. The parser decoded an existing real wallet proof and the RPC client independently reconstructed a finalized public-mainnet block. A fresh governed nonzero proof with an independently signed checkpoint, separate XMR/USD valuation evidence, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, independent reproduction, and production qualification remain open.
